connector.name: Citadel
connector.registryDescription: Encrypted-first embedded database with vector search and agent memory, exposed as MCP tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package citadeldb-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.citadeldb, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: CITADEL_KEY
env.description: Passphrase that derives the AES-256 key encrypting the database region
